name: govintel
description: Research companies and suppliers from public government records: registry identity, status, public contracts, filed accounts, exclusions and integrity records, and declared ownership, across US federal and state registers and 18 national registers, plus the U.S. defense budget by program. Every fact is sourced.

interface.longDescription: Research a company before you team with it, buy from it, lend to it or invest in it. GovIntel looks up the company in public government registers and reports what they say: who it is, whether it is active, the public contracts it holds, the accounts it has filed, any exclusions or integrity records, and who declares ownership or control of it. It covers US federal contractors (SAM), US state business registers and 18 national business registers outside the US, and resolves each company to its exact registration by government identifier, so companies that share a name are not confused. It also searches the U.S. defense budget by program, so you can see which budget lines fund a line of work. Without an account you get the registry record and summary figures, the same facts GovIntel's public company pages show, with a link to that page. With a GovIntel account you also get the itemized record: filed accounts, contract history, adverse findings and declared ownership. Every answer is a sourced fact; GovIntel does not issue scores, ratings or credit decisions.
defaultPrompt: Use GovIntel to look up F8 Entreprenør AS in Norway and summarize its registry record.
Use GovIntel to screen a supplier before we team with them on a federal bid.
Use GovIntel to find which DoD budget lines fund work like ours.
